recipe.criteria: Prone on mat, legs and trunk stable. Straight arms remain slightly lifted and sweep from overhead through lateral T toward hips within available range, then reverse. 3.5 seconds sweep, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
